verdict.rationale: cfo.ai documents downloading a Page as an Excel workbook that keeps its formulas, which is a real first-party export in a widely readable format. It is per-Page, though, with no evidenced bulk or account-wide export, and nothing about leaving cleanly. MCP read access to the Model is only a building block for extraction, not an export feature, so it earns no credit here. Missing for 10: full-account or bulk export of all data (models, actuals, scenarios, changelog, chats), explicit open formats such as CSV/JSON, documented account exit or data-deletion process, independent or hands-on corroboration.
